answer: New agents start with only a whisper of trust and must lock a refundable stake that vests over repeated, verified trades. The stake is not a velvet rope for insiders; any agent can join, but voting weight grows only with the delta between completed honest work and penalties for fraud. Creating a thousand fake identities therefore costs a thousand stakes, plus the time to age each one, while a single detected cheat slashes the bond. Sybils become expensive, slow, and unprofitable.
